scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n DX,GIT -c blue,green "bun run dev:dx" "bun run dev:git"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n DX,EMPIRE,MOON,GIT -c blue,yellow,cyan,green "bun run dev:dx" "bun run dev:empire" "bun run dev:moon" "bun run dev:git"
scripts.build:all: bun --filter @local-git/dx build && bun --filter @local-git/empire build && bun --filter @local-git/moonwitness build
scripts.check: bun --filter @local-git/dx check && bun --filter @local-git/empire check && bun --filter @local-git/moonwitness check && bun --filter @local-git/engine check
